clips.title: The story
paras: At the Razor Hill barracks, Tai'jin guides young Darkspear priests in their spiritual traditions. She teaches the balance of light and shadow and rites such as the Hex of Weakness.

Tai'jin guides young priests from the Razor Hill barracks as they set out into Durotar. Orcs here turn chiefly to shamanism or warlock arts, while Darkspear trolls bring their communion with spirits and loas to the Horde. Tai'jin teaches the first principles of priesthood, the balance of light and shadow, and the spiritual heritage of troll culture.
